summary.text: Michael Ginsburg is the Republican candidate for Nevada State Assembly District 25 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Democrat Selena La Rue Hatch.
He won the June 9, 2026 Republican primary with 87.9 percent of the vote over Noah Bachman Dodge.

paragraphs.text: Ginsburg lives in Reno, Nevada, and earned an associate degree from Truckee Meadows Community College and a bachelor's degree from the University of Nevada, Reno.

His career experience includes working with Sierra Pacific Power Company, and Ballotpedia lists affiliations that include the City of Reno Neighborhood Advisory Board, the Caughlin Ranch Homeowners Association and the Builders Association of Northern Nevada.
Ginsburg ran for Nevada State Senate District 15 in 2024, winning the Republican primary over Sharron Angle and Charles Neumann with 50.8 percent of the vote.
He lost the November 2024 general election to Democrat Angie Taylor, 54.9 percent to 45.1 percent.
